acceptance.artifact: typed-grant enforcement plus recurrence tests covering all three kinds and the four reproduced escapes
acceptance.assertion: Ownership is enforced by typed grant using the grants block the coordinator has added to path-ownership.json: dir matches at a path-segment boundary, prefix matches only as a basename prefix within the named directory and never across a separator, and file matches by equality only. Reproduced by the coordinator on 2026-08-22: holding only workstreams/po03/evidence/recovery-fault-matrix.json also admitted that name with .evil, X and .bak appended, and admitted a nested path beneath it. This is the same root cause as the fixed traversal defect one level up, string-prefix identity standing in for object identity. owned_prefixes must keep working for cohorts already executing, so enforcement must be additive and must fail closed if a grant lacks a kind.
acceptance.falsified_if: any path outside a typed grant is admitted, or a legitimate write permitted by owned_prefixes is refused, or an untyped grant is silently treated as permissive

hypothesis: check_ownership grants writes to unrelated paths that merely share a string prefix with a file-shaped grant, because it matches by str.startswith with no path-segment boundary and the ownership schema does not distinguish an exact-file grant from an intentional filename-prefix grant.
